scripts.prepare: bun run scripts/gen-version.ts && bun run scripts/gen-web-bundle.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun check -p tsconfig.json && bun check -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && bun check -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && bun check -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json && bun check -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.node.json && bun check -p e2e/desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun --bun run vitest run --project node --project node-isolated && vitest run --project react --project desktop-main --project desktop-renderer
scripts.test:speed: RUN_SPEED_TESTS=1 bun --bun run vitest run --project node packages/client-core/src/markdown.speed.test.ts apps/controller/src/tasks/tracking.speed.test.ts
scripts.build:binary: bun run scripts/gen-version.ts && pnpm --filter @hercule/web build && bun run scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts && bun run scripts/gen-web-bundle.ts && bun build packages/hercule/src/main.ts --compile --outfile hercule
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm --filter @hercule/desktop build && bun run scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts apps/desktop/out/renderer --route apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/__root.tsx --route apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_connected.tsx --route apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_connected/_shell.tsx --route apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_connected/_shell/index.tsx --route 'apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_connected/_shell/threads/$sessionId/route.tsx' --route 'apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_connected/_shell/threads/$sessionId/index.tsx' --guide && bun run scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts --main-startup apps/desktop/out/main/index.js --guide && pnpm --filter @hercule/desktop package
